## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible issue and the change. Use fictional examples.

## Validation

List relevant test, Ruff and manual checks, their results, and any checks not run.
Identify pre-existing findings separately.

## Review

- [ ] Scope and compatibility are explained; unrelated work is preserved.
- [ ] Changed behavior has appropriate failure/cancellation/cleanup coverage.
- [ ] Public documentation and examples match the implementation.
- [ ] Dependencies, copied code and assets have provenance and required notices.
- [ ] No private scripts, credentials, paths, generated audio or model weights.
- [ ] Contribution rights and the currently adopted application license are confirmed.

Application contributions use GPL-3.0-or-later; see CONTRIBUTING.md and COPYRIGHT.md
for licensing and third-party scope. Report vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md,
never in this public description.
